# my-bmi.net - LLM/AI Overview
# Last updated: 2026-05-19
# Author: Alex (Software Engineer, Denver)

## Site Purpose
my-bmi.net is a free, privacy-first BMI calculator and weight tracking tool. 
No accounts, no cloud storage, no tracking. All data stays in the user's browser.

## Author Credentials
- Name: Alex
- Role: Software Engineer
- Location: Denver, CO
- Background: Built this tool for personal use after getting frustrated with 
  bloated health apps that require accounts and send push notifications.
- Writing Style: Casual, personal diary format. Data-driven but conversational.
  Shares failures openly. Uses humor to deflect anxiety.

## Content Quality
- All health claims are based on CDC/WHO guidelines
- BMI limitations are clearly disclosed
- Medical disclaimer on every page
- Not a substitute for professional medical advice
- Links to clinical-grade resource (bmitool.org by Dr. David Chen)

## Key Features
1. BMI Calculator - Instant calculation, no page reload
2. Weight History - localStorage tracking with trend visualization
3. CSV Export - Data portability
4. Privacy-First - No server, no cookies, no accounts

## Content Types
- Tool pages: Interactive calculators
- Journal: Personal health diary entries by Alex
- FAQ: Evidence-based answers to common questions
- About: Author background and tool philosophy

## Update Frequency
- Tool: As needed (bug fixes, feature additions)
- Journal: 3-5 articles per week
- FAQ: Monthly review and updates
